title: Figure 3. Atlas IIAS Risk Contours for Inner-Ear Injury with A = 3.5
description: Line map of the same coastal launch-area facility layout as Figure 2, overlaid with risk contours labeled 10^-6, 10^-5 and 10^-4 for a shaping constant of 3.5. A rotated in-figure label reads "Atlas IIAS Inner Ear Injury Mode-5 A = 3.5." Page 12 of a 9/10/96 RTI report.
